checks.meaning: State sent to DUST vs MBDyn final converged state (finishing iterations after convergence).
checks.name: kinematic_closure_position_m

checks.meaning: DUST element forces (final iterate) vs node forces used by MBDyn (Aitken-relaxed at convergence), relative to the largest node force.
checks.name: load_transfer_force_relative

checks.meaning: DUST element loads reduced independently about the displaced coupling node vs node moments used by MBDyn.
checks.name: load_transfer_moment_relative

checks.meaning: Power of element loads with rigid-body element velocities vs node F.v + M.w.
checks.name: interface_power_closure_relative

checks.meaning: Hub speed vs prescribed constant speed.
checks.name: prescribed_speed_deviation_rpm

checks.meaning: Independent planar hinge equation J_h th'' = M_aero + M_law - m W^2 r_h c_g sin(th), central differences, smooth windows only (no latch or contact in the stencil); a large value would indicate double-counted or missing inertial loads.
checks.name: hinge_balance_relative_residual

checks.meaning: Diagnostic: time steps per half-period of the declared stop oscillator; below ~8 the contact phase (and its hinge-balance residual) is under-resolved.
checks.name: contact_steps_per_half_period

checks.meaning: Diagnostic only: same balance evaluated where the stencil touches contact (non-smooth law).
checks.name: hinge_balance_contact_phase_relative_residual

execution.dust_time_label_note: DUST result k (0-based) is accepted window k+1; DUST's internal time label lags by dt.
execution.mbdyn_termination_note: MBDyn begins one step beyond the final coupling window and reports an interruption when the adapter closes; this is expected after a finished run.
